snippet.title: Trailer New Super Mario Bros The missing italian
snippet.description:
New Super Mario Bros.: The Missing Italian is an NSMBW mod whose development began in late 2024.
Drawing inspiration from a world where progress is never straightforward, this project transforms real-life pressure into pure challenge. Travel through a series of extremely challenging levels, some of which are Kaizo and require exceptional precision and concentration.

Mod is not affiliated with Nintendo
